topic: Type Traits and Template Specialization for Type Transformation
explanation: In modern C++, type traits are template-based mechanisms that allow compile-time introspection and transformation of types. They enable writing generic code that adapts based on type properties, such as removing pointers or references from types. This is achieved through template specialization and SFINAE (Substitution Failure Is Not An Error), allowing the compiler to select appropriate type transformations during compilation, which enhances code flexibility, safety, and efficiency.
keywords: Type traits, Template specialization, Compile-time type transformation, C++ type introspection
